RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL  ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Thursday, December 2, 2010/Agrahayana 11, 1932 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Prime Minister; Atomic Energy; Culture; External Af fairs;
Housing and Urban Poverty Alleviation; Overseas Indian Affairs;
Parliamentary Affairs; Personnel, Public Grievances and
Pensions; Planning; Social Justice and Empowerment;
Space; Tourism; Urban Development; Water
Resources; Y outh Affairs and Sports)
Total number of questions — 20
98
Reservation in private sector
*321. SHRI ISHWAR SINGH: Will
the  Minister  of  SOCIAL  JUSTICE
AND EMPOWERMENT be pleased to
state:
(a) whether the National Commission
for Scheduled Castes has demanded 15 per
cent reservation for SCs in employment in
private sector;
(b) whether the Commission has
contended that since a large number of
private entrepreneurs avail loans from
public sector banks and financial
institutions and enjoy other incentives
and tax breaks, private sector should
reciprocate   this by providing employment
to SCs to the extent of 15 per cent;
and
(c) whether Government had earlier
broached the subject to private sector and
if so, the response thereto?
Release of water from Hathni Kund
Barrage
*322. SHRI RAJKUMAR DHOOT:
Will the Minister of W ATER RESOURCES
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Haryana
released huge quantity of water on many
occasions from Hathni Kund Barrage,
which caused floods in Yamuna river
deluging populated areas;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the reasons why water could not be
released in small, controlled and pre-
meditated quantities at intervals to prevent
floods in catchment areas;
(d) whether excessive and surplus water
in the overflowing rivers was stored for
water harvesting during lean period
anywhere in the country despite knowledge
of further monsoon rains, thereby resulting
in unprecedented flooding; and

99
(e) if so, the details thereof?
Nurturing of sports talent in the
country
*323. SHRI SHADI LAL BATRA: Will
the Minister of YOUTH AFFAIRS AND
SPORTS be pleased to state:
(a) the details of the schemes
implemented by Sports Authority of India
(SAI) for spotting and nurturing of sports
talent in the country;
(b) the quantum of funds allocated and
expenditure incurred on sports promotion
during the last three years, State-wise,
sport-wise and year-wise; and
(c) the details of achievements made in
international sports during the last three
years?
Demand of houses in the country
*324. SHRI MOHAMMED AMIN:
Will the Minister of HOUSING AND
URBAN POVERTY ALLEVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) the present demand of housing in
the country, State-wise and low cost,
medium cost and high cost-wise;
(b) whether the demand can be met
within the next five years;
(c) whether there is any scheme to
provide low cost housing to construction
workers in all the States and UTs;
(d) the schemes meant for providing low
cost housing to urban poor people; and
(e) the details thereof?
CAG's findings in procurement by
nuclear plants
*325. SHRIMATI SHOBHANA
BHARTIA: Will the PRIME MINISTER
be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Comptroller and
Auditor General (CAG) has recently found
that 94 per cent of all procurements made
by nuclear plants were given out to a single
or limited vendors;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether the CAG has asked the
Department of Atomic Energy to stop such
'secretive purchases'; and
(d) the steps that are being taken to
make the procurement process more fair
and transparent in the nuclear energy sector?
Maintenance of privacy in Unique
Identity Cards
†*326. SHRI UPENDRA
KUSHWAHA: W ill the PRIME
MINISTER be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Unique
Identification Authority of India has been
established for making Unique Identity
Cards for people of the country;
(b) whether it is a fact that there would
be an expenditure of ` 45,000 crore on this
scheme during the next four years;
(c) whether it is also a fact that all private
information about the people in the said
identity card would become public, which
would be a violation of the fundamental
rights of the people; and
(d) if so, the arrangement being made to
maintain the privacy of individuals of the
country?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

100
Regularization of colonies in Delhi
*327. SHRI MOHAMMED ADEEB:
Will the Minister of URBAN
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) the details of the colonies in Delhi
for whose regularization hurdles have been
cleared recently; and
(b) the steps being taken for speedy
development of such colonies?
Promotion of traditional folk art
forms
*328. SHRIMATI KANIMOZHI: Will
the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to
state:
(a) the steps taken by Government to
promote traditional folk art forms and
details thereof;
(b) total budgetary allocation for
promotion of folk art forms for the current
year; and
(c) whether this is only a small
proportion of the resources allocated for
contemporary arts and if so,
